description: This file defines the TagRepository class implementing the ITagRepository interface, providing methods for CRUD operations and streaming tags from Firestore, specific to handling tag data within the application.

classes.name: TagRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of ITagRepository for managing tag data in Firestore.

methods.name: streamTags
methods.description: Streams a list of tags, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: streamTag
methods.description: Streams a single tag by ID, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a tag by ID, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a tag in Firestore.

methods.name: _requireUid
methods.description: Helper method to ensure a valid user ID is available for operations.
